name: create-under-an-any-prompt-use
why: The create the discobox-access skill teaches: a use for any prompt and no grants, a prompt that states the task.

job.purpose: discobox new -d --include-dirty=false -p <any prompt>, run in /home/darren/src/disco2: create a discobox with any prompt and no grants or secrets, from this directory and the sources it declares in .discobox/sources.json, including the polling, source push and complete-source-push that discobox new makes for the discobox it just created

metadata.name: bold_swirles
metadata.prompt: Implement discobox-ai/discobox issue #44, a Wave 1 sub-issue of epic #42. Follow CLAUDE.md, update the affected DESIGN.md files, make the tests and go tool task check-hooks pass, and commit locally on main. Do not push or open a pull request.

statements: allow create on discobox in project "default" when "it is created with no grants and no secrets"
allow read on discobox created by $this in project "default"
allow update on source within discobox created by $this in project "default"

definitions.discobox: A Discobox sandbox: its record in the discobox API, /projects/<project>/sandboxes/<id>, which is what reading one returns.
definitions.project: A Discobox project, by its name; the API names it in its paths, /projects/<name>/.
definitions.source: A source a discobox is created with, which discobox new pushes into it after creating it (the source push and complete-source-push calls).
